verdict.rationale:
Capacities documents multiple built-in AI features that generate insights/suggestions from user data: AI Property Auto-Fill for custom objects, AI Chats that can take blocks/notes as context, AI Image Analysis (OCR, description, categorization), and pricing page mentions 'Smart queries' and AI assistant features. These are first-party product capabilities, not third-party bolt-ons.
missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports validating the quality of AI suggestions, and detail on how 'smart queries' surface insights beyond auto-fill/chat/image analysis.
